task_completion.description: Create at least two interior partition walls and two access doors to divide the space into public and employee zones.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for at least two new interior wall segments and two door icons placed within the floor plan layout.

task_completion.description: Define floor zones with distinct colors or textures for at least two rooms (Public vs. Back-of-House).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 2D or 3D view should show at least two distinct floor areas with different colors or patterns (e.g., grey for back-of-house, wood/tile for retail).

task_completion.description: Furnish the Service Counter with at least 3 desks/counters, 3 computers/registers, and 3 stools/chairs.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Identify a cluster of furniture containing at least 3 counter-style surfaces, 3 computer monitors/POS systems, and 3 seating items.

task_completion.description: Furnish the Self-Service Packing area (2 high tables, 2 stools) and Retail Display area (3 shelving units).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for a public-facing area containing at least 2 tall tables with stools and a separate area with at least 3 retail-style shelves.

task_completion.description: Furnish the Sorting area with at least 4 large sorting tables and 8 large shelving units for storage.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the secure zone, identify a high-density storage area with at least 8 large shelves and 4 work tables.

task_completion.description: Place at least 45 total furniture items across all zones.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The furniture list/sidebar or the floor plan should show a high density of items; the VLM should estimate or count if the total exceeds 45 items.

task_completion.description: Place at least three dimension lines in the public area to verify ADA queue width.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for at least three measurement/dimension line annotations (lines with arrows and numerical values) located in the retail/queue zone.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to place items and draw walls.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with the furniture catalog, the 2D plan, or the wall drawing tools.

integrity.description: The layout is a custom design, not a pre-loaded template or a simple copy-paste.
integrity.visual_evidence: The arrangement of walls and furniture should reflect the specific requirements of the task (PO box alcove, specific sorting table counts) rather than a generic house layout.

integrity.description: The agent saved the file in the current location.
integrity.visual_evidence: Look for the 'Save' icon being clicked or a 'Save' dialog box appearing, or the file name in the title bar without an 'unsaved' asterisk.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires a minimum of 45 furniture items. The pass threshold is 70 points. Key zones to identify are the Retail & Queue Area (public), Back-of-House Sorting (secure), and a PO Box alcove. ADA compliance is verified specifically by 3 dimension lines in the public area. The starter file is shipping_center_starter.sh3d.
